# AegisLex — Phase 4: Upload Flow Localization Report

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `upload.component.ts` | Injected LanguageService; `getStatusLabel`, `processFiles` error toast, `simulateUpload` success toast, `download` toast localized |
| `upload.component.html` | 32 `lang.t()` bindings covering all upload UI chrome |

## What Was Localized

**Page Header**
- "Upload Documents" title
- "Upload PDFs, images, and documents for AI analysis" subtitle
- "View Cases" button

**Upload Options**
- "Assign to Case" label
- "(optional)" suffix
- "No case — upload to library" default option
- "Auto-analyze with Saul" toggle label
- "Run AI analysis immediately after upload" toggle description

**Drop Zone**
- "Drag & drop documents here" idle text
- "Release to upload" drag-over text
- "or click to browse your files" subtitle
- "Maximum file size: {50}MB per document" limit notice
- "Arabic & English OCR supported for scanned documents" OCR notice

**Upload Queue**
- "Uploading {n} file" / "Uploading {n} files" header (singular/plural)
- "Clear completed" button
- Status labels: "{n}%" / "Analyzing..." / "Complete" / "Failed"
- View document aria-label
- Retry upload aria-label
- Remove file aria-label

**All Done Banner**
- "All uploads complete!" title
- "Your documents are ready for analysis." description
- "Chat with Saul" button
- "View Cases" button

**Supported Formats Info Cards** (4 cards)
- PDF Documents title + description
- Images & Scans title + description
- Word Documents title + description
- Arabic & English OCR title + description

**Toast messages**
- "File too large" error
- "Upload complete" success

## What Was NOT Localized (per spec)

- `item.file.name` — file name (user data)
- `formatFileSize` output uses numeric format only — no language-specific text
- Case option display: `c.caseNumber — c.title` — user data
- Format badge chips (PDF / PNG / JPG / TIFF / DOCX / DOC) — kept as technical acronyms, not UI labels
- Upload logic, file validation, file processing — completely untouched

## Memory Leak Fix Preserved

The existing `ngOnDestroy` memory leak fix from Phase 2 (clearing upload intervals) is preserved
and enhanced with `activeIntervals` tracking — all intervals are cancelled on component destroy.
